findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "scanverity_get_assessment" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Use this after requesting Scanverity research, or when the user asks for an existing report or its progress. Read one saved assessment ID; no new report is crea…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scanverity_search_markets · Private data: scanverity_request_assessment · Public sink: scanverity_request_assessment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scanverity_search_markets · Private data: scanverity_request_assessment · Public sink: scanverity_request_assessment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
